capabilities: highlight MLIR syntax in editor code blocks
disambiguation: It only adds MLIR highlighting to code blocks; it does not edit or validate MLIR.
extras: Installation is described for an older settings UI (Settings > Third-party plugin), suggesting the README predates current Obsidian versions.
intentEvidence: This plugin is mostly the fork from cm-editor-syntax-highlight-obsidian but only supporting the MLIR syntax highlighting
problem: Obsidian does not highlight MLIR (Multi-Level Intermediate Representation) code blocks, so compiler IR snippets are hard to read.

relations.evidence: This plugin is mostly the fork from cm-editor-syntax-highlight-obsidian

summary: Syntax highlighting plugin that renders MLIR code blocks with MLIR-specific highlighting in the Obsidian editor.
